name: Equation Group
description: The Equation Group is the NSA's Office of Tailored Access Operations (TAO), widely considered the most sophisticated state-sponsored hacking unit ever documented. Active since at least 1998, the group developed tools including EternalBlue and EternalRomance, later leaked by The Shadow Brokers in 2016-2017. EternalBlue was subsequently weaponized in the WannaCry and NotPetya attacks.
